kript.keno: Rigas Velestinlis, in the Appendix of his Constitution (New Political Administration, 1797), describes the flag of his democratic polity, which is three-coloured (red, white, black) and bears three crosses, symbols of the Orthodox faith, as well as the ______ of Heracles, as an element of connection with the ancient Greek vigour.
kript.plires: Rigas Velestinlis, in the Appendix of his Constitution (New Political Administration, 1797), describes the flag of his democratic polity, which is three-coloured (red, white, black) and bears three crosses, symbols of the Orthodox faith, as well as the club of Heracles, as an element of connection with the ancient Greek vigour.
kript.infos: Rigas’ three-coloured flag designed in the manuscript of his Constitution.@(Source: Library of the Academy of Romania)

kript.keno: The flag that Alexandros Ypsilantis raised in Jassy, on 22 February 1821, was the flag of Rigas, differentiated as to the symbols: instead of the club, it bore the regenerated ______ on one side and the cross on the other one.
kript.plires: The flag that Alexandros Ypsilantis raised in Jassy, on 22 February 1821, was the flag of Rigas, differentiated as to the symbols: instead of the club, it bore the regenerated phoenix on one side and the cross on the other one.
kript.infos: Ypsilantis assumes the chief command of the struggle for freedom, 1852. Peter Heinrich Lambert von Hess (1792-1871)@Lithograph 28,5 x 21,5 cm. Hellenic Parliament Art Collection, inv. no. 306.

kript.keno: The flag that features in the representation «Mavrokordatos defends Missolonghi» (from the frieze in the Hall of the Trophies) is the flag of the land forces, which had square shape, ______ colour and bore a white cross, that extended over its whole surface.
kript.plires: The flag that features in the representation «Mavrokordatos defends Missolonghi» (from the frieze in the Hall of the Trophies) is the flag of the land forces, which had square shape, blue colour and bore a white cross, that extended over its whole surface.
kript.infos: Mavrokordatos defends Missolonghi@(from the frieze in the Hall of the Trophies)

kript.keno: The ______, as symbol of faith, features constantly on all revolutionary flags, given that the Church formed diachronically the main gathering hub of the Greeks during the Turkish rule.
kript.plires: The cross, as symbol of faith, features constantly on all revolutionary flags, given that the Church formed diachronically the main gathering hub of the Greeks during the Turkish rule.
kript.infos: The Greeks receive the blessing in Missolonghi@Montereau Factory. Faience plate, diameter 21 cm. Varkarakis Collection, inv. no. 178.

kript.keno: In various patriotic ceremonies of the Greeks for the declaration of the Revolution there were used as emblems different local flags, the so-called ______.
kript.plires: In various patriotic ceremonies of the Greeks for the declaration of the Revolution there were used as emblems different local flags, the so-called bairaqs.
kript.infos: Patriotic ceremony of the Greeks, ca. 1870. Alphonse de Neuville (1835-1885)@Lithograph, 37 x 52,5 cm. Hellenic Parliament Art Collection, inv. no. 377.
